boundary.description: From Duddel Brook passing Dean Brown, E along Dean Brown then, Starling Brook and W along River Ribble, then SW to Salesbury Hall and in a straight line to Salloms OS665342, NW to Catterall and Lower Madgell Bank, W by River Ribble to and along diocesan boundary to Spade Mill Reservoir, then W along Lower Rd, Clitheroe Rd and Dean Brown to its crossing with Duddel Brook.
